title: A Systematic Analysis of Out-of-Distribution Detection Under Representation and Training Paradigm Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2511.11934v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a systematic benchmark of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection confidence scoring functions (CSFs) through a representation-centric lens. Our study spans CNN and ViT backbones, multiple training paradigms, four image-classification source datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SuperCIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet), and OOD datasets grouped into near, mid, and far regimes based on CLIP-derived semantic distances. To compare CSFs across these settings, we employ a rank-based pipeline of Friedman and Conover tests that identifies top cliques of statistically indistinguishable winners under threshold-free ranking metrics (AURC and AUGRC). The main empirical finding is that the family of CSFs that are competitive detectors correlates with characteristics of the learned representation. translated_title: 表征与训练范式转变下分布外检测的系统性分析
translated_abstract: 我们通过以表征为中心的视角，对分布外（OOD）检测的置信度评分函数（CSFs）进行了系统性基准测试。我们的研究涵盖了CNN和ViT骨干网络、多种训练范式、四个图像分类源数据集（CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、SuperCIFAR-100和TinyImageNet），以及根据CLIP导出的语义距离划分为近、中、远三个区间的OOD数据集。为了在这些设置中比较各CSFs，我们采用了基于排序的Friedman和Conover统计检验流程，在无阈值的排序指标（AURC和AUGRC）下识别出统计上不可区分的顶级获胜者集团。主要实证发现是：具有竞争力的检测器CSF家族与模型学习到的表征特征相关。对于CNN和ViT，简单的概率评分在误分类检测中占主导地位；在CNN上，基于边际的评分在近OOD区间中表现最强，而……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文以表征为中心，对分布外检测的置信度评分函数开展了系统性基准测试，并通过统计检验发现：具有竞争力的评分函数家族与模型学习到的表征特征密切相关，其表现因骨干网络类型和OOD距离区间而异。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic, representation-centric benchmark of OOD detection confidence scoring functions, using statistical rank-based tests to show that competitive detector families correlate with characteristics of the learned representation across CNN/ViT backbones, training paradigms, and near/mid/far OOD regimes.
